title: Designing with colour
slide_intent: Teach designers to select accent colors for associations they can evoke and to control their relative prominence in a composition.
strategic_value: Voltera can connect blue to the research associations reported in interviews and green to circuit boards while keeping a common palette across products.
demonstration: The page assigns 60% of a design to monochrome, 30% to the primary accent and 10% to the secondary accent. Four equal swatches identify the available colors.
practical_value: Use the percentages to plan a design and the swatches to choose the exact values. Check the guide’s dark-background guidance before setting accent-colored text.
